note: Reviewed terminal outcomes. Every fact and line points at the game file that sets or shows it; the reviewer only decides which outcome is wanted. `selection: one` means the game's own journal descriptions are alternatives, not that a wiki says so.

ciri_witcher.label: Ciri lives: witcher ending
ciri_witcher.review_note: Ciri survives q502 and this save never set q110_to_emperor, so the q505 free-Ciri epilogue is the terminal state. The q110 Velen line is the decision; the q502 phase fact is the confirmation; the q505 journal ending is the evidence.

guidance.mechanism: Choosing Velen keeps Ciri away from Emhyr; the other line sets q110_to_emperor. The line itself does not set q502_ciri_survives, which q502_avallach sets later.

ciri_empress.label: Ciri lives: empress ending
ciri_empress.review_note: Ciri survives q502 and q110_to_emperor is set. The q504 epilogue journal is the terminal evidence; this is not one of the four requested targets.
ciri_empress.guidance_reason: The emperor path is reachable, but it is not one of the requested outcomes; the matrix reports its state without recommending its line.

ciri_dead.label: Ciri dies in the White Frost
ciri_dead.review_note: q502_ciri_dead is set in q502_avallach and tested by the epilogue and ending boards; the q503 ending journal is the terminal evidence. Not guided: several earlier choices lead here and no single line is the decision.
ciri_dead.guidance_reason: No single reviewed line decides this outcome; the q502 phase fact is the terminal evidence.

baron_wife_cured.label: Baron: his wife is alive
baron_wife_cured.review_note: The mission calls this the cured outcome. The save's own q107 journal is 1002193 (Q107 Anna Crazy End): Anna is alive but her mind is lost, and the baron takes her away to find help. q105_evil_spirit sets q105_evil_spirit_destroyed on the branch that reaches this end; q107_swamps sets q107_anna_is_crazy. The data does not claim she is sane, and it does not require the release branch.

guidance.instruction: Speak to the spirit in the cave beneath the Whispering Hillock.
guidance.mechanism: No dialogue line is the reviewed decision: this is the journal objective for the spirit encounter. The terminal branch is the phase fact q105_evil_spirit_destroyed, and q107_swamps sets q107_anna_is_crazy.

baron_anna_lost.label: Baron: his wife is lost
baron_anna_lost.review_note: q107_baron_hanged_himself is set in q107_swamps; the q107 journal description 1002197 says the baron hanged himself after Anna was lost. This is the alternative terminal state, not a recommended goal.
baron_anna_lost.guidance_reason: This is the alternative to the requested cured outcome; the matrix reports its state without recommending its line.

olgierd_saved.label: Hearts of Stone: Olgierd is saved
olgierd_saved.review_note: The q605 temple line [Help Olgierd.] is the reviewed action. q605_finale sets q605_mirror_banished when Gaunter is defeated; the q605 journal ending 1124241 says Olgierd is safe and the pact dissolved.

guidance.mechanism: This line has no fact-setting branch in branches.json; the q605_finale phase sets q605_mirror_banished, and the q605 journal ending 1124241 confirms Olgierd is safe.

olgierd_dead.label: Hearts of Stone: Olgierd dies
olgierd_dead.review_note: q605_mirror_banished is absent after q605_finale, so the pact was fulfilled; the q605 journal ending 1124242 says Olgierd's life came to an end. This is the alternative, not a recommended goal.
olgierd_dead.guidance_reason: This is the alternative to the requested outcome; the negative q605 fact is the terminal evidence, so no line is recommended.

bw_both_sisters.label: Blood and Wine: both sisters live
bw_both_sisters.review_note: Buying the ribbon at the fairy tale keeps Syanna alive for the ceremony, and the reconciliation line keeps Henrietta alive. Both are extracted scene choices with exact lines; the q705 journal ending 1154626 is the terminal evidence.

guidance.instruction: I'll pay you for the ribbon.
guidance.mechanism: The line sets q704_ft_ribbon_won, which is required for Syanna to survive the fairy tale.
The line sets q705_henrietta_alive; the q705 journal ending 1154626 is the terminal evidence.

bw_henrietta_dies.label: Blood and Wine: Anna Henrietta dies
bw_henrietta_dies.review_note: The ceremony line 1198496 sets q705_henrietta_dead; the q705 journal ending 1154625 says Syanna killed her sister. This is the alternative, not a recommended goal.
bw_henrietta_dies.guidance_reason: This is the alternative to the requested both-sisters outcome; the matrix reports its state without recommending its line.

baron_anna_burnt.label: Baron: his wife burns
baron_anna_burnt.review_note: q107_anna_burnt is set in q107_swamps; the q107 journal description 1002195 says Anna burst into flames and died after the attempt to lift the curse. This is an alternative terminal state, not a recommended goal.
baron_anna_burnt.guidance_reason: This is an alternative to the requested cured outcome; the matrix reports its state without recommending its line.

baron_anna_disenchanted.label: Baron: his wife dies after the curse
baron_anna_disenchanted.review_note: q107_anna_disenchanted is set in q107_swamps; the q107 journal description 1002196 says the curse was lifted but Anna died soon afterwards. This is an alternative terminal state, not a recommended goal.
baron_anna_disenchanted.guidance_reason: This is an alternative to the requested cured outcome; the matrix reports its state without recommending its line.
